summary: Tested Section 58 (MongoDB indexes audit + code splitting + console silencer), Section 59 (NotFound + EmptyState), and Stories 24h ephemeral. All 9 backend tests pass (3.0s). All ~12 new indexes verified in MongoDB (incl. TTL stories.expires_at expireAfterSeconds=0, unique story_views (story_id, viewer_user_id), provider_profiles compound). NotFoundPage renders correctly on unknown URL with animated countdown 5s->4s, 4 quick-link pills, and go-now button. Stories carousel renders publicly on /comunidad with provider tile + badge 3 + viewer modal opens. UI login form submission via Playwright did not trigger /api/auth/login (backend works perfectly via curl) — minor Playwright incompatibility tied to multiple type=submit buttons in nav/oauth section; NOT a backend bug.

ui_bugs.issue: Multiple buttons have type="submit" (lang-toggle, mobile-menu-toggle, login-google-button, login-apple-button, login-facebook-button). When wrapped in a form, any of these can trigger an unintended submit. Recommend type="button" except for the actual login-submit.

React warns: 'Invalid DOM property fetchpriority. Did you mean fetchPriority?' — JSX uses camelCase. Update /app/frontend/src/lib/imageHelpers.js lazyImg() to emit fetchPriority instead of fetchpriority.

Pressing Escape did not close the fullscreen story-viewer modal in our test (viewer count stayed 1). The close 'X' button at top-right is present and visually works, but adding an Escape-to-close keyboard listener would improve UX.

integration_issues.flow: UI login submission via Playwright headless
integration_issues.issue: Clicking [data-testid="login-submit"] (force=True) did not produce a network POST to /api/auth/login. Manual curl on the same endpoint returns 200 + session cookie correctly, so the backend is fine. Likely due to the multiple type=submit buttons in the surrounding DOM confusing form semantics, or a guard in the login handler. Worth a manual self-test by main agent: open browser, navigate to /login, attempt login as demo.provider — confirm it works.

action_items: (MEDIUM) Change non-submit nav/oauth buttons from type=submit to type=button in Navbar + LoginPage. May be root cause of UI login submit not firing.
(LOW) Update /app/frontend/src/lib/imageHelpers.js lazyImg() — use fetchPriority (camelCase) in JSX to silence React warning.
(LOW) Add keyboard Escape handler to StoryViewer for close.
(SELF-TEST) Main agent: manually verify login flow works in a real browser session (UI submit) for demo.provider — confirms whether the Playwright issue is also reproducible for real users.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/stories correctly throttles at 5 active stories — verified 429 returned on 6th creation attempt with cleanup-on-finally pattern in tests.
GET /api/stories/active groups by provider with no duplicate rows (verified by set comparison).
TTL index on stories.expires_at uses expireAfterSeconds=0 — relies on MongoDB scanning expires_at as datetime; confirmed via index_information().
story_views has unique (story_id, viewer_user_id) — dedup confirmed: second POST /api/stories/{id}/view by same viewer kept views_count at 1.
Admin can delete others' stories (verified). Client (non-owner) cannot (403 verified).
MultipleButtons with type=submit in login form is a long-standing HTML semantics bug — should be cleaned up.
imageHelpers.js silenceConsoleInProd() is gated on NODE_ENV !== 'production' so dev logs unaffected — correct.

success_rate.frontend: 70% (carousel + viewer + 404 page verified; story-create-tile, story-creator-modal, EmptyState screens blocked by UI login issue)

test_credentials: Provider: demo.provider@getamano.com / provider123 — verified via curl on /api/auth/login returns 200 + session cookie.
seed_data_creation: Tests are self-cleaning. The throttle test creates up to 6 stories and deletes them in finally{}. The full-cycle test creates 1 and deletes it. The demo_provider_user_id fixture creates+deletes a throwaway story to discover the user_id. Net new stories added: 0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Section 58 indexes + stories endpoints are solid (9/9 backend tests passing in 3s). NotFoundPage + Stories carousel both work in production frontend. The only blocker for full UI E2E is form submission via Playwright on /login — backend curl works flawlessly. If you re-test, prefer setting cookies directly via page.context.add_cookies() with a JWT from the curl login response, then navigate to /comunidad. Use BASE_URL = REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Demo provider already has 3 seed stories (María's Cleaning Services, user_3e47ee2b3526).
